messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
Is it permissible to operate the UR10e robot with the Teach Pendant detached, as long as a different source of emergency stop has been defined?

response.text: È consentito far funzionare il robot UR10e con il Teach Pendant scollegato, purché sia stata definita un'altra fonte di arresto di emergenza?
